new_claims.statement: For R=h(X)+(2Xc+d) dot Z with independent cap-one X,Z, sup_t E|R-t|^-1/2 <= 2^(11/4)||c||_2^-1/2.

After a nonzero original scalar pivot a, a Schur center-to-bank packet with zero bank principal block and cross norm B yields ||p_Q||_inf <=2^(11/4)/sqrt(|a|B), with arbitrary outside curvature/couplings.
If the zero-diagonal bank interaction graph is chi-colorable and its center cross mass is B0, then ||p_Q||_inf <=2^(11/4) chi^(1/4)/sqrt(|a|B0).
